display_name: Tri 源域批次梯度波动参照
description: 十类与六源原始 E20 各 12 批，比较 L–L、U–U 及 L–U 梯度方向。
authorization: 用户要求优化 Tri 梯度冲突并详细记录；不改变当前 U 标签权限。

code.environment: N607 ordinary account, existing CVS-RFFI Python, CPU 2, FP32

data.dataset: original ten-class ManyRx and six-source receiver contracts
data.support_query_ref: not applicable; source-only, no target query

permissions.claim_scope: six correlated source snapshots, fresh AdamW moments only

checkpoint.initialization: matching original paper same-setting scratch E20
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: checked at execution: scratch, source-only, same seed and source contract
checkpoint.selection_rule: both original user-requested settings, fixed seed and first three source batches

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, two CPU threads; no GPU workers
execution.stop_rule: Stop diagnostic on identity, role, finite-value, derivative or guard-backward mismatch; do not affect other jobs.

expected_artifacts: 24 fixed E20 source batches including original no-query checks
within-setting L-L, U-U, same-batch L-U and cross-batch L-U per-group relations
24 disposable source snapshots with no model or optimizer state used for training

metric_names: complete L and original raw U group gradient norm, dot and cosine
L-L, U-U, same-batch L-U and cross-batch L-U distributions

rows.purpose: distinguish L/U disagreement from source minibatch gradient variation
rows.seed_notes: Fixed offsets 0/1/2 use CPU random seeds 2026092701+offset.
rows.scenario: source-only L and U; no target
rows.budget_ref: 24 source batches and 48 disposable fresh-moment AdamW shadow steps

notes: No target, source V or U true labels are read; no training state is saved.
12 batches per setting share the same E20 parameter checkpoint but differ in batch, augmentation and possible forward buffer state.
Pairwise batch comparisons are dependent and are not 66 independent experiments or multiple model seeds.
The historically target-exposed seed is used for source diagnosis only.
